title: Middle-income Americans are feeling the squeeze
summary:
America's middle earners are feeling the squeeze.
Just over half of middle-income Americans say they don't have rainy-day funds that would cover expenses for three months in the event of an emergency.
Meanwhile, 47% of middle-income earners — and a measly 24% of lower-income earners — reported being able to save money in the past year.
Fifty-one percent of lower-income respondents said they can pay all of their bills in full in the 2026 survey, down from 56% in 2020.
For middle-income respondents, the share dropped from 81% in 2020 to 78% in 2026, while the share of upper-income respondents held steady at 93%.
